articles.title: Aurora Drape — Dance (Green Toxic)
articles.summary: Glossy black base with wavy orange-red flame bands rippling sideways; broad soft-edged licks, dark and fiery. Reads as black with glowing orange-red lava stripes weaving across it, like heat haze or aurora curtains in fire colours; bold and high contrast.
articles.what: Procedural flame finish: aurora drape structure with the dance spec mode (green toxic palette). FRACTURED FLAMES. Up close: Wavy vertical flame ribbons, 40 to 70 px wide, in glowing orange-red with yellow-orange cores, snaking up and down across a pure black ground. Edges are soft and blurry, with no fine grain. In this render the colour is fire red-orange, not green. From a distance: Reads as black with glowing orange-red lava stripes weaving across it, like heat haze or aurora curtains in fire colours; bold and high contrast. Measured spec (average): metal 216, roughness 39, coat 235. Shine: gloss. Metal: full. It brings its own colours.
